mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ad_click_projection_fact(event_id,qualification_id,visible_receipt_id,click_receipt_id,advertiser_id,budget_date,amount,payload_hash,payload_json) VALUES(#{eventId},#{qualificationId},#{visibleReceiptId},#{clickReceiptId},#{advertiserId},#{budgetDate},#{amount},#{payloadHash},#{payloadJson}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO ad_click_projection_receipt(receipt_id,event_id,kind) SELECT receipt_id,event_id,kind FROM (VALUES (#{visibleReceiptId}::uuid,#{eventId}::uuid,'VISIBLE'), (#{clickReceiptId}::uuid,#{eventId}::uuid,'CLICK')) AS incoming(receipt_id,event_id,kind) ORDER BY receipt_id ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT payload_hash FROM ad_click_projection_fact WHERE event_id=#{eventId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ad_click_projection_daily(advertiser_id,budget_date,click_count,charged_amount) VALUES(#{advertiserId},#{budgetDate},1,#{amount}) ON CONFLICT(advertiser_id,budget_date) DO UPDATE SET click_count=ad_click_projection_daily.click_count+1, charged_amount=ad_click_projection_daily.charged_amount+excluded.charged_amount, updated_at=clock_timestamp()
